compatibleChanges.rationale: Retains the additive optional commandId plus device-pairing and command-receipt request variants while sharing the existing attachment declarations with canonical timeline payloads. Existing request fields and variants remain unchanged; older daemons continue parsing old requests and reject only newly invoked RPC variants they do not implement. The compaction timeline item additionally gains optional outcome and error fields; its status enum stays loading|completed, so an older app parses every terminal compaction exactly as before and simply ignores the refinement.

Retains the additive optional turnOutcome, feature flags, device-pairing, push-catch-up, and command-receipt responses, and adds optional imageCount and attachments to canonical user timeline rows. Existing response fields and variants remain unchanged; older clients ignore optional object fields and never receive new RPC responses unless they send the corresponding new request. The compaction timeline item additionally gains optional outcome and error fields; its status enum stays loading|completed, so an older app parses every terminal compaction exactly as before and simply ignores the refinement. The compaction timeline item also gains an optional turnId (Daseo 6ef0fdbb1) that older apps ignore. Canonical user timeline rows additionally gain one optional origin field ("system") marking Paseo system prompts; all existing fields and variants remain unchanged, and an older app ignores the optional field and renders the row as a plain user message.
Adds one optional E2EE v2 metadata object while retaining v:2, serverId, daemonPublicKeyB64, and relay unchanged, so older clients parse the same offer and use the legacy authenticated channel.
